description: The API call in log_event uses a very small read timeout (1.5s) which may prematurely abort valid requests.
remediation_recommendation: Increase the read timeout to 3-5 seconds and implement retry logic with exponential backoff for ReadTimeout errors.

description: The code does not attempt to retry transient ReadTimeouts, causing requests to fail immediately.
remediation_recommendation: Add a retry loop which retries on ReadTimeout (and optionally 5xx HTTP errors) with backoff.

description: Chained API calls lack isolation; an upstream failure causes downstream calls to also fail.
remediation_recommendation: Implement fallbacks, timeouts, or a circuit breaker to isolate upstream failures and prevent full cascade.
